dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: REST-meta-MDD project (provided by the DIRECT consortium).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "These data were obtained from a publicly accessible dataset from the REST-meta-MDD project (Yan et al., 2019) provided by the DIRECT consortium (Chen et al., 2022)."

answer.REST-meta-MDD: HC for normative model training/testing (10-fold CV) and final model training; MDD patients for deviation estimation and subtype clustering.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HC n=822 used for normative model development with 10-fold cross-validation, then models trained on all HC and applied to MDD n=797.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "...822 healthy controls (HC..."; "we first performed normative modeling on the HC using 10-fold cross-validation... used 9 folds to train... remaining 1 fold serving as the test set... Then, the normative models were trained on all HC data and later applied to MDD patients."
